subject.title: Discord compaction still fails with provider_error_4xx after #90496 closure on 2026.6.5

question: What should OpenClaw do when a Discord session using Codex hits provider_error_4xx during budget compaction after the context-engine/native ownership fix?
rationale: The current code can surface the Codex native compaction failure, but choosing automatic rotation, transcript preservation, fail-closed copy, or broader model-switch handling changes session-state and provider-routing semantics.

options.title: Add focused provider-4xx recovery
options.body: Define a narrow Discord/Codex policy that preserves or rotates the transcript when native compaction fails with provider_error_4xx, then require live Discord/Codex proof.

options.title: Expose explicit manual recovery only
options.body: Keep the session blocked on provider-4xx but improve the channel-facing cause and recovery command so users are not left with generic context-too-large copy.

options.title: Fold into broader context policy
options.body: Track this only under the larger model-switch/context-overflow policy and keep #92598 as a linked symptom until that policy lands.

recommendation.title: Add focused provider-4xx recovery
recommendation.body: Define a narrow Discord/Codex policy that preserves or rotates the transcript when native compaction fails with provider_error_4xx, then require live Discord/Codex proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The nearest merged follow-up work is #91590, which fixed adjacent Codex compaction ownership while explicitly excluding this recovery policy.
